about: The licence audit (SECURITY.md, rule 10): what the game and its tools use that no lockfile holds, each with its licence (SPDX) and where it comes in. The core's check (core/scripts/licences.mjs, with scripts/licences.json) holds each entry to its list: 'ships' (it reaches a player, so scripts/notices.mjs writes its 'notice' into the notices the web build ships) to floor rule 10's list for what ships, the rest, tools that only run, to the tools' list; its scan (core/scripts/licence-scan.mjs) fails a PR that uses an action, a fetched package, an asset or copied-in code no entry names. 'files': the files or folders an entry covers.
